name: The Brass Migration
prompt: Show a flock of copper swifts in successive stages of unfolding along a diagonal wire. At one end a clockmaker holds a flat folded blank. At the other, flying swifts carry tiny spare springs to the next workshop.

name: The Courtesy Machine
prompt: Build a procession of wooden mechanical hands on wheeled pedestals. Each passes the same fragile blue teacup to the next using a different grip. Mechanics adjust exposed linkages beneath the fingers while onlookers follow the cup.

name: An Orchestra Under Glass
prompt: Arrange thin glass bells in a crescent, each sheltering a tiny mechanical insect. Their legs strike the glass in turn. A keeper rolls a single immense punched-paper score past the crescent on a low brass trolley.

name: The Self-Mending Elephant
prompt: Make a bulky indigo enamel elephant with one flank hinged open as a repair balcony. Smaller mechanical elephants carry replacement plates up a ramp made from its lowered trunk. The help travels in both directions.

name: The Sleepwalking Wardrobe
prompt: Send four tall lacquer cabinets walking on jointed wooden legs. One kneels beside a visitor and opens, revealing miniature clockwork figures folding donated clothes. Show the little balancing weights swinging outside each cabinet like tails.
